title: Checkout returns 500 for every customer
description: Since 09:40 all payment attempts fail with HTTP 500. Revenue is at zero.

title: Refund emails arrive twice
description: Customers get two refund confirmation emails. Refund itself is issued once.

title: orders-db replica lag above 10 minutes
description: Read replica is 12 minutes behind the primary; reports show stale numbers.

title: Users cannot log in with SSO
description: Okta SAML login fails with an assertion error for everyone. Password login still works.

title: Production API is down
description: Every endpoint times out. Load balancer health checks failing across all zones.

title: Typo on the pricing page
description: 'Anual plan' should read 'Annual plan'.

title: Disk on backup server 92% full
description: Nightly backups will stop in about three days at the current rate.

title: VPN disconnects every hour
description: Staff on macOS are dropped from the VPN every 60 minutes and must reconnect.

title: Search results missing new products
description: Products added today do not appear in search; the index job last ran yesterday.

title: Possible data leak via public S3 bucket
description: A bucket with customer exports was found publicly readable.

title: Android app crashes on launch after update
description: Version 5.2 crashes immediately on Android 14 devices. iOS is fine.

title: Slack alerts integration stopped posting
description: The webhook to #incidents returns 410 Gone since this morning.

title: Monthly revenue report export is slow
description: The CSV export for the finance report takes 4 minutes instead of 30 seconds.

title: Grafana dashboard shows no data
description: The latency panels are empty since the Prometheus upgrade.

title: Password reset links expire immediately
description: Reset links say 'expired' the moment they are opened. Users are locked out.

title: Connection pool exhausted on payments-db
description: Payments service logs 'remaining connection slots are reserved'; checkout intermittently failing.

title: Button misaligned on settings page in Safari
description: The save button overlaps the footer on Safari 17. Cosmetic only.

title: Invoices generated with the wrong tax rate
description: German invoices since the 1st use 16% VAT instead of 19%.

title: Newsletter unsubscribe link broken
description: Clicking unsubscribe in the weekly newsletter shows a 404 page.

title: TLS certificate for status page expires tomorrow
description: The certificate on status.example.com expires in 24 hours; auto-renew failed.
